changelog: **Session agendas — the panel and the API (#1843, part 1):** `/api/agendas` (`GET ?relationId=` / `?meetingId=`, `POST` from a guide or empty), `/api/agendas/[id]` (`GET`/`DELETE`), `/api/agendas/[id]/items` (`POST` an ad-hoc line), `/api/agendas/[id]/items/[itemId]` (`PATCH` tick/reword/reorder, `DELETE`), `POST /api/agendas/[id]/carry-over` (a new agenda on the pairing holding every unticked line, each marked `carriedFromItemId` and keeping its template reference), and `GET /api/agendas/templates` (the tenant's live guides for the picker). Authorization is the relation's (`src/lib/agendaAccess.ts` mirrors `relationIfAllowed`: admin, mentor, mentee; another tenant's agenda answers 404, a tenant-mate outside the pairing 403) plus `loadAccessibleMeeting` for a meeting-pinned agenda, and the archived-relation lock answers the existing 409 `inactive_relation`. Writes publish a new `agenda` realtime event for the relation (moves no unread counter, ignored by the inbox refresher), so `AgendaPanel.tsx` — guide picker, live tick, ad-hoc line, carry-over, read-only for archives, mentor-only facilitation notes — shows both seats the same list without polling. Mounted on `/mentor/mentees/[id]` and `/portal/goals`. EN/TR/DE `agenda.*` keys. E2E `e2e/session-agenda.spec.ts` (`@smoke`: pick → tick → carry-over, 403 for a third party, 409 on an archive). `/admin/agenda-templates` follows in part 2.

en: Every mentoring session can now have an agenda: pick one of the guided conversations or start an empty list, tick the points off together during the call — both of you see the same list update live — and carry whatever was not finished into the next session.
tr: Her mentorluk oturumunun artık bir gündemi olabilir: rehberli konuşmalardan birini seç ya da boş bir listeyle başla, görüşme sırasında maddeleri birlikte işaretle — ikiniz de aynı listeyi anlık görürsünüz — ve bitmeyenleri bir sonraki oturuma devret.
de: Jede Mentoring-Sitzung kann jetzt eine Agenda haben: wähle einen der Gesprächsleitfäden oder beginne mit einer leeren Liste, hakt die Punkte während des Gesprächs gemeinsam ab — beide sehen dieselbe Liste live — und übernimm, was nicht geschafft wurde, in die nächste Sitzung.
